own_scenes.desc: Los Cocteau Twins dan otra vuelta a la psicodelia: melodías sublimes en la voz etérea de Elizabeth Fraser, envueltas en capas oníricas de guitarra y teclado de Robin Guthrie (Head Over Heels, Treasure). Ivo Watts-Russell (4AD) y This Mortal Coil; Dead Can Dance, que trasladan la exótica mística de Third Ear Band, Popol Vuh y Clannad a la era del dream-pop (Spleen And Ideal); los noruegos Bel Canto y A R Kane, pioneros del trip-hop.

podcast.title: 80s Alt-Rock Radio Inclusion
podcast.body: Ethereal dream pop was among the diverse genres featured on alt-rock radio playlists in the 1980s, demonstrating the broad range of music played before the rise of grunge.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early 90s Mention
podcast.body: Dream pop was mentioned as one of the many forms of Alt Rock that enjoyed moments in the sun during the 90s, highlighting the breadth of alternative sounds beyond the mainstream. "We could have just as well mentioned, early emo, dream pop, math rock, post-hardcore, alt metal, alt country, Tweet Rock, contemporary Christian alternative music, and so many more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influence on The Cranberries
podcast.body: The Cranberries' guitar sound occasionally showed influences reminiscent of dream pop, linking them to a specific stylistic lineage. "aquella influencia que a veces se recordaban esas guitarras a mi bloody ballanta igual de mi pop."

podcast.title: Integration with Electronic Music
podcast.body: Boards of Canada's "The Campfire Headphase" is described as sounding like a dream pop band integrated into electronic music, rather than an electronic band influenced by dream pop, contributing to the evolution of the genre. "a veces parece más una banda de Drimpop integrada en la electrónica que una banda de electrónica influenciada... es un viaje muy romántico por lo que es la evolución del Drimpop."

srcs.episode: BOARDS OF CANADA. La visión romántica del IDM

podcast.title: Renewed Dream Pop
podcast.body: Lowtide's debut album is praised for its contribution to a "renewed dream pop" sound, with comparisons drawn to Cocteau Twins. "este nuevo dream pop renovado que hacen que más interesante de pareció, es como me recuerda muchas veces a los coctotunes."

podcast.title: Romantic and Nostalgic Sound
podcast.body: Dream pop is characterized by a nostalgic and romantic sound, which is present in Boards of Canada's music, particularly in "Music Has the Right to Children" and "The Campfire Headphase." "este disco tiene muchísimas emociones contenidas de tras el sonido instrumental, desde inspiraciones en la naturaleza tiene un sonido muy nostálgico, muy romántico, a veces incluso recuerda el dream pop."

srcs.episode: BOARDS OF CANADA. La visión romántica del IDM

podcast.title: Subgenre of Post-Punk
podcast.body: Dream pop is identified as one of the styles that falls under the post-punk umbrella, characterized by immersive music with heavy atmospherics, texture, and effects. "Goth, dark wave, dream pop, the jangly guitars, bands like R.E.M., the spiky stuff of groups like Wire and Shoegay's were, and in some cases still are, artists in those buckets that we can consider to be post-punk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Wide Appeal and Influential Acts
podcast.body: Dream pop has a broad appeal, with Boards of Canada being recommended for fans of established acts like My Bloody Valentine, Spiritualized, Slowdive, Ride, and Mogwai. "cualquiera avante del Drimpop de My Lord Ivan Lanta, de Spiritalize, de Slowdive, de Ride, incluso de Mokuey o de My Lord Ninjaked, va a pasarse, vamos, va a maravillarse con lo que es Borsov Canadá."

srcs.episode: BOARDS OF CANADA. La visión romántica del IDM
